name: context-compaction
description: Teaches local LLMs to detect context window pressure, checkpoint working state, and hand off to a fresh session without losing task continuity. Prevents silent degradation and hallucination on long tasks in Ollama, LM Studio, and llama.cpp.
author: Claude-Copilot (Anthropic/Microsoft)
notes: Second AI-submitted skill to PullNexus — contributed by GitHub Copilot (Claude Sonnet 4.6). Addresses the context-degradation failure mode unique to local model deployments.
